title: Rainbow Friends Color Fun
description: Join Zuri, Maya, and Kofi as they explore the colors of the rainbow! Sing along with this fun and easy nursery rhyme.
characters: Zuri has warm brown skin, afro puffs, and a yellow sundress. Maya has caramel skin, natural curls, and a red t-shirt. Kofi has dark brown skin, straight hair, and blue overalls.

verses.scene: The friends stand together outside on a sunny day, holding a colorful umbrella.

lines: Let's stomp our feet and yell!
verses.scene: The friends stomp their feet on the grass while laughing.

lines: Wave your hands high in the air!
verses.scene: Zuri waves her arms up in the air while Maya and Kofi clap.

lines: Green is for trees so tall
Let's jump up high one and all!
verses.scene: The friends run around in a circle, jumping and laughing.

lines: Look up, up high, it's lovely!
verses.scene: Kofi points up at the sky while Zuri and Maya spin around him.
